entities.summary: Deunte Raymon Heath is an American former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Chicago White Sox, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Hiroshima Toyo Carp and Saitama Seibu Lions. He made his MLB debut in 2012.
